content:
Good afternoon all, my name is Thomas Eastgate. I am natively from Hong Kong but I currently reside in the UK. I have just completed my GCSEs, but I believe it is useful for everyone to want to do independent research by themselves and it is with this in mind that since Year 10 I have been doing questions in TFL and FOL. Recently I found out about the Natural Number Game which brought me into the beautiful hole that is Lean.

I can communicate well in Cantonese, Chinese and English (English much preferred). I am moderately adept in Japanese, and thanks to the British school system I did one year each of French and Spanish (please don't test me, I'm terrible at both). If I am not off doing questions in undergrad level maths and physics, which is extremely rare right now, I am probably doing music or watching random YouTube videos which is my alternative to doomscrolling ever since I quit every social media account I had except Discord.

I definitely don't call myself amazing in logic and proof, and I do want to learn more in the hope that it one day boosts my university application, and because logic is a great area of maths in general. Hoping to learn more about everyone here soon (well not everyone that'll be a lot).
